description.value: Nourish Kitchen is an inclusive community eatery in Sechelt on BC's Sunshine Coast, helmed by Chef Cheryl with over 20 years of experience and a farm-to-table philosophy using local, seasonal ingredients. The kitchen caters equally to vegans, gluten-free diners, and traditional meat eaters, offering dine-in, takeout, catering, and chef's table experiences. Touring cyclists will find a genuinely accommodating stop with global flavours and adventure-ready meal packs designed for on-the-go eating.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for nourishforyou.com is fully accessible and provides a Sechelt, BC address (102-5674 Teredo Street), a phone number (604 838 7439), and confirms the business is actively operating with summer 2026 event listings. The site explicitly promotes vegan, gluten-free, and meat-eater-inclusive menus, and features a prominent 'Order Take Out' function plus adventure/picnic packs described as 'conveniently packed in a cooler bag with an ice pack ready for your adventure.' No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water refill details appear anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Nourish' but the website consistently identifies the business as 'Nourish Kitchen' — the OSM record may be missing the second word of the name.

OSM community is tagged 'Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Sechelt is located on the BC Sunshine Coast (mainland side), not on Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands — possible community mis-categorization in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant in Sechelt with a verified website, physical address, and current 2026 programming. A useful stop for touring cyclists with inclusive dietary options and adventure meal packs.
enrichment_extras.notes: Address, phone, and email were sourced entirely from the website as OSM tags contained no contact information. The website email is general@nourishforyou.com.

Packed lunches.detail: Adventure Menu includes 'POWER PICNIC' and 'CANOODLE PICNIC' options described as 'conveniently packed in a cooler bag with an ice pack ready for your adventure,' portioned for 2

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Gluten-free, vegan, low-carb, or any special dietary preferences' are accommodated; menu items include GF and vegan labels (e.g., 'GF Glory Salad', 'V' tagged picnic items)

wow_evidence: adventure/picnic packs described as 'conveniently packed in a cooler bag with an ice pack ready for your adventure'
